name: Mari's Magical Deliveries
source:
Mari is a college-aged witch who returns home for the first time in years to help her dad's delivery service. While delivering packages, she meets some familiar faces from grade school...

[from [url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/maris-magical-deliveries]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Mari是一位大学生年纪的女巫，多年来第一次返乡，帮父亲经营配送业务。送包裹的途中，她遇见了几位小学时代的熟面孔……

[摘自[url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/maris-magical-deliveries]itch.io[/url]]
